headline: LH to Buy Up Unsold Units from No-Rank Subscriptions; 'Supply Expansion' Effectiveness Sparks Controversy
summary: Remaining private sale units in the Seoul capital area that sold through no-rank subscriptions are expected to be converted into public rental housing. Critics question whether the supply expansion will be effective.
why: Housing policy in South Korea affects construction activity, property prices and household wealth, and changes to subscription rules influence the residential market.
